open_issues: The expected real result is unverified. Run `cargo run --bin athena -- backtest` in the full repository.
The refusal-word list is a guess. If the real text of ar1x lacks all of those words in the clause that holds HTTP 405, nothing is derived. Extend the word list if so.
Pickaxe `-S` on the heading line assumes the heading was never reworded before D87's introduction commit.
The `Starts` argument to `run_on` and `run_signals` is a breaking API change; the in-repo callers and tests are updated.
I did not edit the module doc comment at the top of backtest.rs. It still lists four steps and does not mention condition (e).
mistakes: I ran `git show HEAD:docs/decisions.md --stat`, which dumped the whole file; it was a wasted call.
The first `cargo run -- backtest` failed because I left out `--bin athena`.
learnings: The workspace has two binaries, so `cargo run -- backtest` needs `--bin athena`.
Bash here allows no pipes and no tail or grep, so large cargo output cannot be filtered; use narrow `--test` runs.
The working snapshot's git history is one commit, so start_from_history gives a meaningless start there.
`git -C` is denied by policy; the code calls git through std::process::Command, which is not subject to that check.
